### The Call of Isaiah
Author: Ligonier Ministries
Site: Ligonier Ministries
URL: https://learn.ligonier.org/devotionals/call-isaiah
Passage: Isaiah 6:6-7
Points:
- God revealed His immense glory and supreme holiness to Isaiah in the heavenly temple.
- Even the most righteous prophet was undone by the stark contrast between human sin and divine purity.
- The coal applied to Isaiah's lips shows that God Himself provides the necessary atonement and cleansing.
- John 12 clarifies that Isaiah was beholding the pre-incarnate Christ on the throne.
- The holy Creator took on human flesh to grant sinners full pardon and restoration.

### Do You See Without Seeing? Isaiah’s Riddle and Christ’s Rescue
Author: Brian Tabb
Site: Desiring God
URL: https://www.desiringgod.org/articles/do-you-see-without-seeing
Passage: Isaiah 6:9-10
Points:
- Isaiah received a troubling commission to proclaim a message that would confirm the people's spiritual dullness.
- Israel's inability to see and hear reflected the lifeless idols they persistently worshiped.
- Jesus cited Isaiah 6 to explain why many rejected His kingdom message and misunderstood His parables.
- Opposition to the gospel fits a long biblical pattern of God's messengers facing rejection.
- True spiritual sight and hearing require God to intervene mercifully to heal human hearts.

### Face to Face with the Holy One
Author: John MacArthur
Site: Grace to You
URL: https://www.gty.org/blogs/print/B200701/face-to-face-with-the-holy-one
Passage: Isaiah 6:3-7
Points:
- In a season of national grief and uncertainty, Isaiah caught a glimpse of the sovereign King of hosts.
- Witnessing God's pure holiness compelled the prophet to confess his personal depravity and ruin.
- The altar coal placed on Isaiah's mouth pictured divine purification and atonement.
- Only after receiving God's forgiveness was the prophet prepared to answer the call to serve.
- The glorious God before whom Isaiah trembled is Jesus Christ, who humbled Himself to save sinners.
